more_info.overview: Heptyl para-hydroxybenzoate is a benzoate ester formed from para-hydroxybenzoic acid and a seven-carbon alcohol group. This entry identifies the heptyl ester specifically. Its historical preservative classification is distinct from that of other paraben esters. Current food examples, a commercial production route and a applicable intake limit were not confirmed for this record.
